content.comment_body: I'm looking for a way to open [document] files on my iPad. I've been searching for a couple of days without success. Could anyone assist? Apologies for my English, it's not my first language. An IPA file would also be helpful.
If you're German, why not post in the German section of the forum? It might help you get more relevant responses.

To clarify: regardless of the language used, the answer remains the same—no solution is available. The only software that opens [document] files is [product_name], which is unavailable for iOS or Android, and doesn't run even on a Raspberry Pi running Debian Linux.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wishes to open [document] files on an iPad but discovers that this is only possible with [product_name], which operates solely on desktop systems and not on mobile platforms. This highlights a key limitation: users can't view or edit project files on iOS devices due to restricted software support, which disrupts cross-device workflows.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the ability to open, view, or edit [document] files on iOS devices, ideally via a dedicated app or compatible software for iPad. They are also interested in solutions such as an IPA file for direct iOS compatibility.
